name: SmartRoom
summary:
This application aims to showcase what guests, both new and returning, can expect and how one of the rooms at the Cartagena Plaza Hotel, part of the EM Hotels group, looks like.

The application strives to create a virtual and interactive experience of what to anticipate when visiting one of these rooms, allowing individuals to explore from the comfort of their homes. Its purpose is to inspire them, help them fall in love with the accommodations, and assist them in making a decision on which hotel to stay a
